summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases (pinned v1.3.13) into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript blob using a rotated string-array VM; `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (e.g. `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`). The package advertises itself as an account-resources initializer for OneReach and has no documented need for the Bun runtime or for executing an opaque bundled payload at install time. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated blob under `preinstall` bypasses Node-based tooling and hides the payload's real behavior (including any network destinations, credential access, or persistence) from static review. The installation-time execution fires automatically on `npm install` without user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
